hooks.command: f=$(perl -ne 'print "$1" if /"file_path"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/'); t="/tmp/__pmpm_hk.$$"; case "$f" in *Screen_*.html) perl -0777 -ne 'while(/<script\b([^>]*)>(.*?)<\/script>/gis){next if $1=~/\bsrc\s*=/i; next if $2=~/^\s*$/; print $2,"\0"}' "$f" | while IFS= read -r -d '' body; do printf '%s' "$body" > "$t.js"; r=$(osascript -l JavaScript -e 'function run(a){ObjC.import("Foundation");var s=$.NSString.stringWithContentsOfFileEncodingError(a[0],$.NSUTF8StringEncoding,null);try{new Function(s.js);return "OK"}catch(e){return "FAIL: "+e.message}}' "$t.js"); [ "$r" != "OK" ] && echo "SYNTAX GATE FAIL in $f: $r"; done; rm -f "$t.js" ;; *PRD_*.html) xmllint --noout "$f" 2>"$t.err" || echo "SVG/XML not well-formed in $f: $(head -1 "$t.err")"; rm -f "$t.err"; n=$(perl -0777 -pe 's{<defs\b.*?</defs>}{}gis' "$f" | grep -coE '<(rect|circle|line|path|text|polygon|polyline|ellipse|image|use)\b'); [ "$n" = "0" ] && echo "SVG WARNING in $f: 0 shapes outside <defs> — diagram may be blank" ;; esac; exit 0
